title: Website development
paragraphs: I develop multi-page websites, corporate sites, landing pages, portfolios, blogs, and online stores — always with performance, accessibility, and SEO in mind.
For each project, I pick the stack that fits your goals — custom code from scratch or no/low-code platforms like Webflow, Webstudio, Shopify or Framer.

title: Website Migration
paragraphs: Is your site on WordPress, Webflow, Framer, or Tilda, and the platform is holding it back? I move it to Astro + Sanity. The design stays the same, the site gets faster, cheaper to host, and easier to edit.

Your SEO stays in place: every old URL gets a 301 redirect, and titles, meta tags, and structured data move with the content. After a 6-language WordPress migration, weekly search impressions grew about 4×.

title: Website Upgrades
paragraphs: Is your site loading slowly, not ranking well, underperforming, or looking outdated? I'll pinpoint what's holding it back and make it work harder for your business. From complete redesigns to precise technical improvements, I make websites faster, more engaging, and easier to grow.
Performance optimization, SEO improvements, design updates, animations, better user experience, and accessibility improvements.

title: Web Design
paragraphs: Design isn't my specialty, though I designed this site myself.
I can work from your design or with your designer. If you don't have one, I partner with designers I trust. They create the visuals, and I turn them into fast, accessible websites.
